name: Minarai Taimashi Maji de Ikimasu!
original_name: 見習い退魔師 本気でイキますっ！
source: Amano is the daughter of an exorcist. One day her father tells her to put on some special clothes and come with him. He leads her to a creature, who takes great interest in Amano...
translation: 天野是一个驱魔师的女儿。某天父亲让她穿上特殊衣服跟他走。他把她带到一个生物面前，那个生物对天野产生了极大的兴趣……
